newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-SAULES BANK MOVES INTO PROFIT IN JAN/FEB.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-SAULES BANK MOVES INTO PROFIT IN JAN/FEB.

text.p: Saules Bank, among the top 10 Latvian banks in terms of equity capital, said on Wednesday that its profit came to 192,000 lats in the first two months of 1997.
The bank in a statement said that in the same period of 1996 it made a loss of 113,000 lats.
The bank also said that assets in the first two months were around 43 million lats, deposits were 32.3 million lats, which included deposits by individuals of 10.7 million lats.
The bank's own capital was around six millions lats.
